title: MGR, Tainan Photo Scanner Process
description:

Fab16s (Tainan) Scanner Process Manager

As a Fab16s (Tainan) Process Manager, you will…

Lead and manage a team of process engineers to oversee process development, optimization, and sustaining in semiconductor manufacturing. Drive process performance, yield improvement, and cost optimization while leveraging AI-driven analytics, automation, and advanced data modeling to enhance decision-making, process control, and operational efficiency. Provide technical leadership and support across manufacturing, equipment, and integration teams.

Responsibilities and Tasks

• Forecast and manage process-related operational costs, including materials, yield loss, and metrology expenses. Drive cost reduction initiatives through AI-based yield analysis and predictive modeling.

• Develop and implement robust process control systems to ensure stability, repeatability, and high yield. Leverage AI-assisted fault detection, root cause analysis (RCA), and knowledge systems to improve excursion response and reduce variability.

• Work closely with Equipment Engineering and Manufacturing teams to address process constraints and optimize OEE, yield, and throughput. Utilize AI/ML models to improve process windows and sampling strategies.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to develop scalable process solutions, integrating AI-enabled monitoring systems, digital dashboards, and smart alerting for real-time process health tracking.

• Provide support to ensure compliance with EHSS requirements, including chemical handling, process safety, and risk mitigation. Utilize digital and AI tools for hazard identification, trend analysis, and compliance tracking.

• Maintain high standards of process discipline, documentation, and housekeeping. Ensure all process changes and controls are tracked through digital systems and automated workflows.

• Ensure employees have the required training, process knowledge, and competencies, including AI literacy, data interpretation, and the use of advanced analytics tools.

• Drive continuous improvement in yield, defect density, and process capability through DOE, SPC, and data-driven methodologies enhanced by AI-based insights.

• Establish and monitor supplier performance for process materials and consumables (e.g., photoresist, chemicals), using data analytics and AI benchmarking to optimize quality and cost.

• Set performance expectations for team members and conduct regular reviews. Build capability by promoting AI adoption (e.g., Copilot, data tools, automation platforms) to enhance engineering productivity and decision speed.
